Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: NaiveSeasonal dominates with lowest RMSE (31.04) and best seasonality correlation (0.614), while ARIMA leads trend tracking (0.0 correlation vs -1.0 for most models). High RMSE spread (0.389), unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.26), and unpredictable series (spectral entropy=0.92) warrant robust median/trimmed-mean combinations over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.

proposer.rationale: The high relative_spread_mean (0.389) and high spectral entropy (0.92) indicate significant model disagreement and series unpredictability, justifying the analyst's recommendation for robust methods (robust_median and trimmed_mean_trim0.2). topk_mean_per_horizon_k2 is included to specifically leverage the 2 unique winners (NaiveSeasonal and ARIMA) while filtering out the high-RMSE models that contribute to the 0.389 spread.
